MEG Energy Corp. (2026). Christina Lake Regional Project 2024 Directive 054 Performance Report, Commercial Scheme Approval No. 10773. Submitted to the Alberta Energy Regulator by Cenovus Energy Inc. on behalf of MEG Energy Corp., 3 February 2026.

Reporting year 2024; the report is dated 3 February 2026 (not 2025) and was submitted by Cenovus on behalf of MEG (now part of Cenovus); id and stem kept as assigned. Written report, not a slide deck. Loaded: 2024 annual bitumen output from the printed 102,012 bbl/d (Sect. 1.1) and the Phase 3 approved 33,390 m3/d as capacity (ambiguous: total vs phase). Other-values: printed SOR 2.39, phase approvals, AP14I cSOR, NCG return share, cumulative production. No steam flow row: steam volume not printed (Fig. 19 actual vs design steam throughput and Fig. 18 bitumen throughput are images without text; not rendered). Not available: fuel gas, electricity, cogeneration ratings or export (Phase 2 and 2B gas-turbine cogeneration with HRSG exist per the compliance table p.10-12), GHG totals (a carbon capture plant application is planned, p.14), produced/make-up/disposal water volumes, steam generator counts (4 OTSGs implied in Phase 2B with a 5th planned, plus a drum boiler), solvent (none; NCG is natural gas). Skipped subsurface maps, monitoring, suspension/abandonment and compliance tables. Locator convention: printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 3). Traps: 2024 leap year 366 d; scheme is SAGD with eMSAGP NCG co-injection, not solvent-assisted; Table 3 header shows Jan 2026.
